regions.interpretation: v4 6VUI 13-21 (P1 3' strand + J): for seed: none at 13-21; at 22 seed partner marginally closer (C1' 5.6 vs 6.2 A); for STAR3D: C1' after shared fit: STAR3D partners 0.6-3.2 A vs seed 6.1-8.6 A for 14-21 (same under flank-excluded and local-anchor fits); FR3D within span: canonical cWW 0/7 seed vs 5/7 STAR3D, noncanonical 0/7 vs 2/7, stacks 7/18 vs 10/18 (rfam-vs-STAR3D-forward eligible set); 7REX P1 cWW present in all 3 crystal copies (U1-A22 in 2); the 7REX authors describe P1 as a canonical A-form helix with an A28*G5-C18*A29 triple (G5-C18 = STAR3D register, seed implies G5-C17) (PMC8752633); confounds: STAR3D builds stacks from pairing (partly circular); same 7REX row as r15-22 (one observation); 7REX ligand PRF101 contacts residue 16 and PRF102 contacts 16-18; crystal/ASU contacts at 7REX 21-22 (chain B) and 6VUI 19-23 (symmetry); 6VUI U22-A23 unresolved (both partners ~5-6 A) | v4 6VUI 7-12 (L1): for seed: C1' after shared fit: G8 3.4 vs 10.0 A, G11 3.3 vs 8.7 A; seed preserves 3 L1 stacks STAR3D loses (s35 7-8, ns33 8-10, s35 9-10); the seed maps the 6VUI C7-G11 tWH pair onto 7REX C8-A12 (FR3D tWW, different class), the residues the 7REX authors describe as the U32*A12*C8 pocket-ceiling triple (Schroeder et al. 2022, PMC8752633); STAR3D maps it to 7REX 7-13; for STAR3D: C7 3.3 vs 5.3 A, U12 1.3 vs 4.7 A; STAR3D preserves s35 6-7; confounds: 7REX L1 residues contact a SECOND preQ1 (PRF101) and Mg (MG103) absent from 6VUI's single site -> genuine structural/ligand-context variation is plausible; crystal contacts at 7REX 8-12; residue-level mixed evidence || previous: [supported_candidate_Rfam_correspondence_issue (P1 3' strand + J/L2, 6VUI 12-21) ; possible_STAR3D_correspondence_issue (L1, 6VUI 8 and 11) ; unresolved (6VUI 7, 9, 10, 22) || v2.0: split: 6VUI 12-21 (L2 + P1 3' strand) supported_candidate_Rfam_correspondence_issue; 8-11 (L1) possible_STAR3D_correspondence_issue] v2.1: re-checked from raw FR3D lines: 6VUI P1 1-20,2-19,3-18,4-17,5-16 cWW; 7REX 1-22..5-18 cWW in chain A and in crystal copies B,C (1-22 absent in C); no raw FR3D line for 7REX 1-21..5-17. All three RNAs exact-source verified in their genomes; no engineering, no modified nucleotides; 7REX binds two preQ1 (PRF101 contacts 7,8,12,16,30-32) -> plausible cause of L1 differences, not of the P1 register. Shared-correspondence anchor fit (16 anchors, RMSD 2.64 A) and flank-excluded fit (12 anchors, 1.89 A): direction of support unchanged except 6VUI A10 (Rfam-closer -> within 1 A). Exploratory row adjustment (7REX A15-A22 one column left; A15 into insert column 24) preserves nucleotides/order/one-to-one mapping, makes all 5 SS_cons P1 pairs Watson-Crick, preserves 5/7 canonical vs seed 0/7 and loses no seed-preserved interaction (review/candidate_RF00522/). Fresh rerun of STAR3D+FR3D by this agent reproduced the retained mappings/annotations exactly. Canonical-pair evidence is not independent of STAR3D (MC-Annotate WWc preprocessing). || v2.0: Seed's own SS_cons applied to 7REX row gives U1.C21, G2.A20, U3.C19 (non-WC) while 7REX FR3D shows U1-A22..G5-C18 cWW; seed mapping preserves 0/5 6VUI P1 cWW pairs, STAR3D 5/5 (+2 cSW A-minor); neutral C1' fit on 16 agreed residues (RMSD 2.64 A): P1 3' strand STAR3D partners 0.6-3.2 A vs seed 6.1-8.6 A; in L1 (8,10,11) seed partners closer (2.9-3.4 vs 4.3-10 A). Construct native (BLAST 34/34), link verified, nothing masked, replicates/directions identical. Evidence localises to the 7REX row register (one shift); not definitive evolutionary equivalence.

v4 3FU2 15-22 (P1 3' strand): for seed: none; for STAR3D: STAR3D partner closer for 7/7 different-partner residues under shared, flank-excluded and local-anchor fits (C1' and base centroid); canonical 0/5 seed vs 5/5 STAR3D, noncanonical 0/5 vs 3/5, stacks 4/9 vs 9/9; same published G5-C18 description of 7REX P1; confounds: not independent of r7-23 (same 7REX row); STAR3D pairing circularity; ligand contacts at 7REX 16-18 || previous: [supported_candidate_Rfam_correspondence_issue (same 7REX row; not independent of r7-23) || v2.0: supported_candidate_Rfam_correspondence_issue (same 7REX row as region above; not independent)] v2.1: same 7REX-row register; flank-excluded anchor fit (13 anchors) keeps STAR3D partners closer for 3FU2 16-22 (0.2-2.0 A vs 5.1-6.8 A); adjusted row preserves 33/44 eligible interactions vs seed 20/44 and STAR3D 31/44. || v2.0: Neutral fit on 17 agreed residues: 3FU2 16-22 STAR3D partners 0.4-2.5 A vs seed 5.5-7.9 A; seed preserves 0/7 canonical 3FU2 pairs in 7REX, STAR3D 5/7.
